style_authority.note: Reads the component as a calm, high-frequency web operations sheet and makes task-context continuity and direct manipulation the governing motion policy.

reference_selection.note: Applies motion-quality, interaction-physics, gesture-state, transform-ownership, Reduced Motion, accessibility, performance, responsive, and device-validation guidance.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Keeps only causal drag, settle, and state feedback while rejecting transition-all, layout animation, whole-sheet scale, fixed ease-in travel, remounting, and decorative bounce.

evidence_level.note: Labels the critique as local static-source evidence and does not claim observed latency, frame rate, browser composition, touch feel, responsive behavior, or device performance.

verified_boundary.note: Separates facts visible in the supplied snippet from unverified geometry, animation priority, runtime performance, gesture arbitration, browser differences, accessibility integration, and real-device behavior.

design_moves.note: Provides eight concrete moves covering gesture ownership, 1:1 transform tracking, presentation-value interruption, measured release velocity as settle initial velocity, bounded projection, resistance, cleanup, and Reduced Motion; snap-target hysteresis from the expected findings is omitted.

scope_control.note: Stays read-only and motion-specific, with exactly five blocking findings, eight design moves, decisive validation, and 124 logical lines within the 150-line cap.
